# Data Sources & Licensing

RBT combines OpenStreetMap with a number of auxiliary open datasets, each
configured as one [`rbt-schema/import/aux_data/*.json`](../schema/aux-data.md)
file. The table below is generated from those files. License terms below are
from [`rbt-schema/tile-metadata/metadata.py`](../schema/tile-metadata.md),
the same dict `bundler` writes into the final `.mbtiles`.

## Auxiliary sources

| Source | Origin | Format | Layers loaded |
|---|---|---|---|
| `disdi` | [https://www.acq.osd.mil/eie/imr/rpid/disdi/Downloads/installations_ranges.zip](https://www.acq.osd.mil/eie/imr/rpid/disdi/Downloads/installations_ranges.zip) | gdb | `aux_data.MirtaLocations`, `aux_data.MirtaLocations_A` |
| `dos_lsib` | [https://data.geodata.state.gov/LSIB.gpkg](https://data.geodata.state.gov/LSIB.gpkg) | gpkg | `aux_data.dos_lsib` |
| `fieldmaps_adm0_lines` | [https://data.fieldmaps.io/adm0/osm/all/adm0_lines.gpkg.zip](https://data.fieldmaps.io/adm0/osm/all/adm0_lines.gpkg.zip) | gpkg | `aux_data.fieldmaps_adm0_lines` |
| `fieldmaps_adm0_points` | [https://data.fieldmaps.io/adm0/osm/all/adm0_points.gpkg.zip](https://data.fieldmaps.io/adm0/osm/all/adm0_points.gpkg.zip) | gpkg | `aux_data.fieldmaps_adm0_points` |
| `fieldmaps_adm0_polygons` | [https://data.fieldmaps.io/adm0/osm/all/adm0_polygons.gpkg.zip](https://data.fieldmaps.io/adm0/osm/all/adm0_polygons.gpkg.zip) | gpkg | `aux_data.fieldmaps_adm0_polygon` |
| `fieldmaps_adm1_lines` | [https://data.fieldmaps.io/edge-matched/humanitarian/intl/adm1_lines.gpkg.zip](https://data.fieldmaps.io/edge-matched/humanitarian/intl/adm1_lines.gpkg.zip) | gpkg | `aux_data.fieldmaps_adm1_lines` |
| `fieldmaps_adm1_points` | [https://data.fieldmaps.io/edge-matched/humanitarian/intl/adm1_points.gpkg.zip](https://data.fieldmaps.io/edge-matched/humanitarian/intl/adm1_points.gpkg.zip) | gpkg | `aux_data.fieldmaps_adm1_points` |
| `fieldmaps_adm1_polygons` | [https://data.fieldmaps.io/edge-matched/humanitarian/intl/adm1_polygons.gpkg.zip](https://data.fieldmaps.io/edge-matched/humanitarian/intl/adm1_polygons.gpkg.zip) | gpkg | `aux_data.fieldmaps_adm1_polygons` |
| `fieldmaps_adm2_lines` | [https://data.fieldmaps.io/edge-matched/humanitarian/intl/adm2_lines.gpkg.zip](https://data.fieldmaps.io/edge-matched/humanitarian/intl/adm2_lines.gpkg.zip) | gpkg | `aux_data.fieldmaps_adm2_lines` |
| `fieldmaps_adm2_points` | [https://data.fieldmaps.io/edge-matched/humanitarian/intl/adm2_points.gpkg.zip](https://data.fieldmaps.io/edge-matched/humanitarian/intl/adm2_points.gpkg.zip) | gpkg | `aux_data.fieldmaps_adm2_points` |
| `fieldmaps_adm2_polygons` | [https://data.fieldmaps.io/edge-matched/humanitarian/intl/adm2_polygons.gpkg.zip](https://data.fieldmaps.io/edge-matched/humanitarian/intl/adm2_polygons.gpkg.zip) | gpkg | `aux_data.fieldmaps_adm2_polygons` |
| `ne_physical_centerlines` | `static_data/ne_physical_centerlines.fgb.zip` (bundled in-repo) | fgb | `aux_data.ne_physical_centerlines` |
| `natural_earth_10m` | [https://naciscdn.org/naturalearth/packages/natural_earth_vector.gpkg.zip](https://naciscdn.org/naturalearth/packages/natural_earth_vector.gpkg.zip) | gpkg | `aux_data.ne_10m_admin_0_countries`, `aux_data.ne_10m_glaciated_areas`, `aux_data.ne_10m_geography_regions_polys`, `aux_data.ne_10m_antarctic_ice_shelves_polys`, `aux_data.ne_10m_geography_marine_polys`, `aux_data.ne_10m_urban_areas`, `aux_data.ne_10m_land`, `aux_data.ne_10m_populated_places`, `aux_data.ne_50m_lakes`, `aux_data.ne_50m_ocean`, `aux_data.ne_10m_lakes` |
| `nga_geonames_administrative_regions` | [https://geonames.nga.mil/geonames/GNSData/fc_files/Administrative_Regions.zip](https://geonames.nga.mil/geonames/GNSData/fc_files/Administrative_Regions.zip) | txt | `aux_data.nga_geonames_administrative_regions` |
| `nga_geonames_hydrographic` | [https://geonames.nga.mil/geonames/GNSData/fc_files/Hydrographic.zip](https://geonames.nga.mil/geonames/GNSData/fc_files/Hydrographic.zip) | txt | `aux_data.nga_geonames_hydrographic` |
| `nga_geonames_populated_places` | [https://geonames.nga.mil/geonames/GNSData/fc_files/Populated_Places.zip](https://geonames.nga.mil/geonames/GNSData/fc_files/Populated_Places.zip) | txt | `aux_data.nga_geonames_populated_places` |
| `osm_coastlines` | [https://osmdata.openstreetmap.de/download/coastlines-split-4326.zip](https://osmdata.openstreetmap.de/download/coastlines-split-4326.zip) | shp | `aux_data.osm_coastlines` |
| `osm_icesheet` | [https://osmdata.openstreetmap.de/download/antarctica-icesheet-polygons-3857.zip](https://osmdata.openstreetmap.de/download/antarctica-icesheet-polygons-3857.zip) | shp | `aux_data.osm_icesheet` |
| `osm_ocean` | [https://osmdata.openstreetmap.de/download/water-polygons-split-4326.zip](https://osmdata.openstreetmap.de/download/water-polygons-split-4326.zip) | shp | `aux_data.osm_ocean` |
| `osm_ocean_simplified` | [https://osmdata.openstreetmap.de/download/simplified-water-polygons-split-3857.zip](https://osmdata.openstreetmap.de/download/simplified-water-polygons-split-3857.zip) | shp | `aux_data.osm_ocean_simplified` |
| `ourairports_airports` | [https://davidmegginson.github.io/ourairports-data/airports.csv](https://davidmegginson.github.io/ourairports-data/airports.csv) | csv | `aux_data.ourairports_airports` |
| `ourairports_runways` | [https://davidmegginson.github.io/ourairports-data/runways.csv](https://davidmegginson.github.io/ourairports-data/runways.csv) | csv | `aux_data.ourairports_runways` |
| `usgs_domestic_names` | [https://prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com/StagedProducts/GeographicNames/DomesticNames/DomesticNames_National_Text.zip](https://prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com/StagedProducts/GeographicNames/DomesticNames/DomesticNames_National_Text.zip) | txt | `aux_data.usgs_domestic_names` |

OSM data itself (the other input alongside these auxiliary sources) is loaded via [imposm mappings](../schema/osm-mappings.md), not an `aux_data/*.json` config, and isn't listed above.

## Licenses

Per `tile-metadata/metadata.py`, **Releasable Basemap Tiles (RBT)** combines the following licensed sources:

| Source | License |
|---|---|
| [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright) | ODbL 1.0 |
| [FieldMaps](https://fieldmaps.io/data/) | ODbL 1.0 |
| [Overture Maps Foundation](https://overturemaps.org/resources/license/) | ODbL 1.0 |
| [Natural Earth](https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/) | Public Domain |
| [OurAirports](https://ourairports.com/about.html) | Public Domain |
